name: Anchor
description: Those strong enough to wield the Anchor in battle follow the tradition of legendary seafaring warriors.

name: Ancient Bow
description: The Ancient Bow is still as sprightly as the day it was first strung.

name: Auto Crossbow
description: The Arch-Illager said the design for this powerful crossbow came to him in a vision.

name: Axe
description: The axe is an effective weapon, favored by the relentless Vindicators of the Arch-Illager's army.

name: Azure Seeker
description: If the color blue had a sound, it would be the shots fired by the Azure Seeker.

name: Baby Crossbows
description: While some dismiss the cute Baby Crossbows, these deadly weapons grow into heavy hitters.

name: Backstabber
description: The preferred blade of thieves and assassins, the Backstabber is a must in any rogue's pack.

name: Battlestaff
description: The battlestaff is a perfectly balanced staff that is ready for any battle.

name: Battlestaff of Terror
description: This staff overwhelms its target in battle to explosive effect.

name: Bee Stinger
description: The Bee Stinger, a swift blade inspired by a bee's barb, can draw friendly bees into the fray to fight alongside you.

name: Bone Cudgel
description: The Bone Cudgel is old enough to be considered an ancient treasure, but still menacing even by modern standards.

name: Bonebow
description: The Bonebow is the pride of Pumpkin Pastures, crafted within the walls of their humble village.

name: Boneclub
description: Those who wield a Bone Club prefer a less-subtle approach to problem-solving.

name: Bonehead Hammer
description: Fashioned in the likeness of a familiar foe, this hammer pulls your opponents towards their doom.

name: Bow
description: A simple but well-rounded piece of weaponry. The hunters of the Pumpkin Pastures say that a bow doesn't let you down, unlike other trinkets.

name: Bow of Lost Souls
description: This bow, made of cursed bones, strips the living of their very souls.

name: Broadsword
description: Only those with the strength of a champion and the heart of a hero can carry this massive blade.

name: Broken Sawblade
description: The Broken Sawblade has been ravaged by time, but it still does considerable damage.

name: Bubble Bow
description: Let your troubles float away with the Bubble Bow, which seals your target in a bubble on a charged shot.

name: Bubble Burster
description: The Bubble Burster creates a chain effect of bubble trouble for your enemies.

name: Burst Crossbow
description: A tactical crossbow favored by warriors and hunters alike, the Burst Crossbow is a powerful tool for any hero.

name: Burst Gale Bow
description: A bow infused with the force of a rolling wind which can flare up in an instant.

name: Butterfly Crossbow
description: This crossbow moves faster than wings in flight and strikes down enemies before they see the bolt.

name: Cackling Broom
description: Sweep your enemies off their feet with the Cackling Broom.

name: Call of the Void
description: You can feel the Void whispering from deep within this bow, but behind that sound is another voice in the darkness.

name: Chill Gale Knife
description: Crafted from the never-melting ice atop the mountain peaks, this knife is forever icy to the touch.

name: Claymore
description: A massive sword that seems impossibly heavy to lift yet rests easily in a just warrior's hands.

name: Cog Crossbow
description: The gears of this ancient Cog Crossbow still turn smoothly, making it a reliable weapon choice to this day.

name: Coral Blade
description: The Coral Blade cuts through enemies with stinging accuracy.

name: Corrupted Crossbow
description: This crossbow has a subtle but corrupting power that is suitable for thieves and nimble warriors alike.

name: Crossbow
description: The crossbow is the ranged weapon of the Illagers and is a common sight among Pillager warriors.

name: Cursed Axe
description: This cursed, poisonous axe leaves their victims sick for years with just a single scratch.

name: Cutlass
description: This curved blade, wielded by the warriors of the Squid Coast, requires a steady hand in battle.

name: Daggers
description: Daggers are the weapon of cravens - or so folk say.

name: Dancer's Sword
description: Warriors who view battle as a dance with death prefer double-bladed swords.

name: Dark Katana
description: A blade that will not rest until the battle has been won.

name: Diamond Pickaxe
description: Diamond is one of the most durable materials, making it an excellent choice for a pickaxe.

name: Diamond Sword
description: The Diamond Sword is the true mark of a hero and an accomplished adventurer.

name: Doom Crossbow
description: Many thought that the Doom Crossbow was just a myth, but this time the rumors turned out to be true.

name: Double Axe
description: A devastating weapon fit for barbaric fighters.

name: Dual Crossbows
description: Dual crossbows are the perfect choice for a warrior with quick reflexes in a fast-paced battle.

name: Echo of the Valley
description: This bow calls upon the twisting winds of the hidden valley where it was first strung.

name: Elite Power Bow
description: The secrets of the Elite Power Bow's construction have been lost without a trace.

name: Encrusted Anchor
description: This Encrusted Anchor was lost at sea long ago and has become harsh and corrosive during its ages of neglect.

name: Eternal Knife
description: A disturbing aura surrounds this knife, as if it has existed for all time and will outlive us all.

name: Exploding Crossbow
description: The power of TNT fused with the latest in archery design resulted in this devastating crossbow.

name: Fangs of Frost
description: These lauded twin daggers of the northern mountains are known to freeze their foes to solid ice.

name: Feral Soul Crossbow
description: If you listen closely you can hear the souls inside the crossbow, usually ridiculing you.

name: Fighter's Bindings
description: Made in the wilds beyond the mountains, these gauntlets have been worn by warriors for centuries.

name: Firebolt Thrower
description: The Firebolt Thrower launches chaos in a chain reaction of exploding arrows.

name: Firebrand
description: Crafted in the blackest depths of the Fiery Forge and enchanted with fiery powers.

name: Flail
description: This ancient weapon inflicts grave blunt damage to those who cannot evade the deadly metal ball.

name: Fortune Spear
description: A spear that is watched over by lucky souls, bringing luck to any who wield it.

name: Freezing Foil
description: This needle-like blade is ice cold to the touch and makes quick work of any cut.

name: Frost Scythe
description: The Frost Scythe is an indestructible blade that is freezing to the touch and never seems to melt.

name: Frost Slayer
description: The legendary Frost Slayer returns to the battlefield only in the darkest and coldest days of winter.

name: Gauntlets
description: Gauntlets call back to an ancient style of hand to hand combat.

name: Glaive
description: The glaive, wielded by the servants of the Nameless One, is a weapon with style and power.

name: Gloopy Bow
description: Entrap your enemies in a strange, syrupy bubble and show them who's boss!

name: Grave Bane
description: A relic from ages of darkness; this glaive radiates potent magical energy to ward off the undead.

name: Great Axeblade
description: A lucky blacksmith turned a workshop blunder into a battlefield wonder, fusing two weapons into something new.

name: Great Hammer
description: Blacksmiths and soldiers alike use the Great Hammer for its strength in forging and in battle.

name: Growing Staff
description: A staff that grows and shifts as it attacks, the Growing Staff is unpredictable and powerful.

name: Guardian Bow
description: Forged from fossilized coral, the Guardian Bow is a remnant from sunken civilizations of lost ages.

name: Hammer of Gravity
description: A hammer, embedded with a crystal that harnesses the power of gravity, that is incredibly powerful.

name: Harp Crossbow
description: Half musical instrument and fully deadly weapon, the Harp Crossbow is the life of the party.

name: Harpoon Crossbow
description: The Harpoon Crossbow shoots harpoons that cut through wind and water with devastating power.

name: Haunted Bow
description: What indescribable horror! The creeping tentacles of this bow reach for the unknowable Void.

name: Hawkbrand
description: The Hawkbrand is the legendary sword of proven warriors.

name: Heartstealer
description: Gifted to one of the Arch-Illager's most distinguished generals upon their conquest of the Squid Coast - this runeblade is infused with dark witchcraft.

name: Heavy Crossbow
description: The weighted crossbow is a damage-dealing menace and a real threat from a ranged distance.

name: Highland Axe
description: Expertly crafted and a polished weapon of war, the Highland Axe also makes a daring backscratcher.

name: Hunter's Promise
description: This enchanted bow deepens the bond between the hunter and their trusted animal companion.

name: Hunting Bow
description: This enchanted bow strengthens the bond between the hunter and their animal companion.

name: Imploding Crossbow
description: The Imploding Crossbow has been magically fine-tuned to maximize the impact of the explosion.

name: Jailor's Scythe
description: This scythe belonged to the terror of Highblock Keep, the Jailor.

name: Katana
description: A blade fit for expert warriors and fighters, its blade is crafted to inflict precision damage.

name: Lightning Harp Crossbow
description: Adding electrical energy to this crossbow changed the firing sound dramatically.

name: Longbow
description: The Longbow, crafted for hunting rather than battle, is still useful in a fight.

name: Love Spell Bow
description: Love can be magical, but when it becomes too powerful, it can turn into a frenzy.

name: Mace
description: The Mace is a brutal tool of war and what it lacks in finesse; it makes up for in power.

name: Master's Bow
description: The bow prefered by the masters of archery across the Overworld, no matter how simple it appears.

name: Master's Katana
description: The Master's Katana has existed throughout the ages, appearing to heroes at the right moment.

name: Maulers
description: These claw-like weapons, wielded by ancient Illager soldiers, are savage in battle.

name: Mechanical Shortbow
description: A brand new development in quick firing technology, this bow packs a swift punch.

name: Mechanized Sawblade
description: The Mechanized Sawblade still glows from the fires of the Nether where it was forged.

name: Moon Daggers
description: These curved blades shine like the crescent moon on a dark night.

name: Nameless Blade
description: This deadly blade's story was lost to the endless sands of time.

name: Nautical Crossbow
description: Why harpoon one enemy when you can harpoon many!

name: Nightmare's Bite
description: The twin blades of Nightmare's Bite drip with deadly venom, still potent after all these years.

name: Nocturnal Bow
description: The souls bound to the bow guide the arrows to their targets and cause it to glow slightly.

name: Obsidian Claymore
description: This massive blade cleaves even the thickest shulker shells with style and ease.

name: Phantom Bow
description: The arrows that take flight from the Phantom Bow swoop down on your enemies like the bow's nightmarish namesake.

name: Pickaxe
description: The pickaxe has been the iconic tool of adventurers and heroes for as long as anyone can remember.

name: Power Bow
description: The question of what makes the Power Bow so powerful has puzzled the minds of learned folk for ages.

name: Pride of the Piglins
description: Found in the farthest reaches of the Nether, the Pride of the Piglins is both vintage and vicious.

name: Purple Storm
description: Named the Purple Storm after its lovely hue, this legendary bow packs a powerful punch.

name: Rapid Crossbow
description: New reloading technology helps this crossbow fire more rapidly than those that came before it.

name: Rapier
description: The rapier, a nimble and narrow blade, strikes with quick ferocity.

name: Red Snake
description: The Red Snake radiates an explosive heat, making it a deadly fire risk in the dry, desert lands.

name: Resolute Tempest Knife
description: Passed down by nomads who roam the mountain peaks, this knife has been used in countless battles.

name: Sabrewing
description: This bow, built for a long-lost champion, feels right in the hands of those who seek justice.

name: Scatter Crossbow
description: This crossbow, modified to hold and fire multiple bolts, is also a half-decent musical instrument.

name: Shadow Crossbow
description: Those who wish to use the Shadow Crossbow must train in total darkness before wielding it.
properties: Chance of Shadow Form on kills

name: Sheer Daggers
description: Even the simplest of farmers can wield these Shear Daggers with savage results.

name: Shivering Bow
description: The Shivering Bow pierces even the most ancient ice and strikes a chill into the heart of any enemy.

name: Shortbow
description: The preferred weapon of thieves and rogues, the Shortbow is nimble and lethal at short range.

name: Shrieking Crossbow
description: As you wield this unsettling weapon, you might find yourself succumbing to the darkness and becoming one with the night.
properties: Chance of Shadow Form upon kills
First shot won't break Shadow Form

name: Sickles
description: A ceremonial weapon that hails from the same region as the Desert Temple.

name: Sinister Sword
description: The Sinister Sword, drawn to those who face the spookiest of nights, cuts through the night with a howl.

name: Skull Scythe
description: Don't ask what unnatural creature's bones were used to build this weapon. You don't want to know.

name: Slayer Crossbow
description: The Slayer Crossbow is the treasured heirloom of many legendary hunters.

name: Snow Bow
description: Those who face the Snow Bow in battle must also prepare to face the chill of freezing wintry winds.

name: Soul Bow
description: The Soul Bow shimmers with all the beauty and fury of an attacking Vex.

name: Soul Crossbow
description: The Soul Crossbow was crafted by the mysterious Evokers and Enchanters of the Woodland Mansions.

name: Soul Fists
description: Soul Fists are gauntlets clad with great gemstones, each containing a powerful soul.

name: Soul Hunter Crossbow
description: This crossbow, crafted in a forge rich with souls, thrives when an abundance of souls are nearby.

name: Soul Knife
description: A ceremonial knife that uses magical energy to hold the wrath of souls inside its blade.

name: Soul Scythe
description: A cruel reaper of souls, the Soul Scythe is unsentimental in its work.

name: Sparkler
description: The Sparkler lights up the party as it cuts through the darkness.

name: Spear
description: The spear, with its long reach and powerful range, is a solid choice of weapon.

name: Spellbound Crossbows
description: Enchanted enemies are especially vulnerable to the magic of these crossbows.

name: Spine-Chill Spear
description: The creator of this terrible weapon was said to have an affinity for giant eyes. Thankfully, this weapon was the extent of their madness.

name: Sponge Striker
description: This blade may look colorless and dead, but it soaks up energy in combat and expels it in a powerful burst.
properties: Deals absorbed damage during attack combo

name: Stormlander
description: The Stormlander, enchanted with the power of the raging storm, is a treasure of the Illagers.

name: Sugar Rush
description: This candy-colored bow has a surprisingly bitter bite.

name: Sun's Grace
description: This mace, engraved with secret healing runes, grants powerful restorative powers.

name: Swift Striker
description: A blade for those who know that the surest way to victory is to strike without being seen.

name: Sword
description: A sturdy and reliable blade.
locations: Inventory if no Melee weapons are present

name: Tempest Knife
description: This knife slices through enemies like the wind that cuts between the mountaintops.

name: The Beginning and The End
description: Forged by the survivors of a doomed expedition to the End, these twin blades carry dark secrets.

image.alt: The Beginning and The End icon

name: The Green Menace
description: The arrows fired from the Green Menace always hit their intended target, even in the thickest fog.

name: The Last Laugh
description: Strange, distorted laughter seems to whisper from these menacing looking sickles.

name: The Pink Scoundrel
description: It would be a deadly mistake to underestimate the power of the Pink Scoundrel.

name: The Slicer
description: The peak of mischievous Illager-engineering, the famous Slicer was designed to fire bolts that pierce through even the thickest of armor.

name: The Starless Night
description: The Starless Night is haunted by echoes of pain that linger within the pitch-black blade.

name: Trickbow
description: A sleek bow that seems to never miss its target.

name: Truthseeker
description: The warden of Highblock Keep kept this unpleasant blade by their side during interrogations.

name: Twin Bow
description: The Twin Bow is the champion of the hero who finds themselves outnumbered and alone.

name: Twisting Vine Bow
description: This bow writhes within your grasp as if trying to wrap its tendrils around everything in its path.

name: Veiled Crossbow
description: The Veiled Crossbow cloaks the wielder in shadow, perfect for those who prefer to go unnoticed (and undefeated).
properties: Chance of Shadow Form upon kills
First shot won't break Shadow Form

name: Venom Glaive
description: A toxic cloud seems to follow the Venom Glaive wherever it goes...

name: Vine Whip
description: A sturdy whip made from thick, thorn-laden vines capable of poisoning anything it touches. Be careful not to scratch yourself!

name: Void Bow
description: When you pluck the string of the Void Bow, an unsettling silence reverberates across the battlefield.

name: Void Touched Blades
description: These Blades are infused with a disturbing purpose after countless ages trapped in the End.

name: Voidcaller
description: This weapon calls out to souls that are trapped between this world and the next.

name: Webbed Bow
description: Crafted from the webs of mighty spiders, the Webbed Bow will get you out of any sticky situation.

name: Weeping Vine Bow
description: The Weeping Vine Bow's toxic vines create a poisonous haze on the battlefield.

name: Whip
description: A whip made of sturdy rope, very dangerous in the right hands.

name: Whirlwind
description: Whirlwind, forged during an epic windstorm, is a double-bladed axe that levitates slightly.

name: Whispering Spear
description: Legend says that this cursed spear is plagued by a soul that controls the mind of any who wield it.

name: Wind Bow
description: A mesmerizing bow that captures the power of the wind to fire mighty Gale Arrows.

name: Winter's Touch
description: Arrows fired from this legendary bow are said to be carried by the winter winds themselves.
